title: Playgama game. 3D game goes to 2D =_=
author: drikanius
selftext:
I have this game on Google Play, and initially, I intended to keep it there. But then I heard about **Playgama** and its support for different platforms, including YouTube Playables (wanna test) and Netflix (which I still don't quite understand how it works 😅), so I decided to give it a try.

Turns out, it was harder than I expected. The size restrictions forced me to redo the entire game as a smaller, simplified version, with everything in 2D and a more pixel-art-ish style.

At first, I tried asking Claude to reduce all the 3D models and textures, but it was a nightmare... I mean, the characters literally looked like they came from a nightmare. 😂

So I redrew everything (with my super amateur art skills) and asked Claude to port the code.

After several hours of babysitting Claude, I finally managed to get the same logic working in this new version.

Well... it took some time, but... here it is!

(I also asked claude to create a vlog comparing 3d/2d)
